بن مالك بن عديّ بن كعب بن عبد الأشهل الأنصارية ثم الأشهلية، أخت سعد بن زيد.
ذكرها الواقديّ في المبايعات. وقال ابن سعد: ولم نجد لها في نسب الأنصار ذكرا.

segments.english:
12287—Umm Niyar bint Zayd ibn Malik ibn 'Adi ibn Ka'b ibn 'Abd al-Ashhal

She was a woman of the Ansar, specifically of Banu 'Abd al-Ashhal, and the sister of Sa'd ibn Zayd.

Al-Waqidi mentioned her among the women who pledged allegiance. Ibn Sa'd said: “We found no mention of her in the genealogy of the Ansar.”

¹ “That is” is omitted from manuscript A.

² Usd al-Ghaba, entry 7617; al-Thiqat, 3/465; A'lam al-Nisa, 5/201, 211; al-Tajrid, 2/337; Tahdhib al-Tahdhib, 12/481; al-Kashif, 3/492; Tahdhib al-Kamal, 3/1706; al-Istibsar, 61; Khulasat Tadhhib, 3/404; Talqih Fuhum Ahl al-Athar, 370; al-Isti'ab, entry 3682.

³ In manuscript A: “Her hadith was transmitted by Muhammad ibn Ishaq.”
